hero-headline:
Your AI weight loss coach.
Everything in one app.
powered-by-ai-grounded-in: Powered by AI, grounded in real evidence.
know-what-to-do-today: A coach that reads your day.
havit-connects-ai-body-composition: Log a meal in seconds. HAVI reads your weight, body composition, sleep, and GLP-1 trends together, then tells you the one thing to do today. In a 12-week clinical study, HAVIT users were 4× more likely to lose 5%+ of their body weight.
works-with-or-without-glp: Clinical study with Eulji University, measured on InBody — not self-reported. Built by Juvis Diet alumni. Works with or without GLP-1.
havit-turns-scattered-health-information: HAVIT turns scattered health information into one daily routine, with guidance designed to help you understand and act on what matters.
follow-estimated-body-composition-and: Follow estimated body composition and wellness trends over time.
use-a-photo-to-receive: Use a photo to receive an estimated calorie and nutrient breakdown.
turn-healthy-intentions-into-small: Turn healthy intentions into small, achievable actions with missions, streaks, and visible progress.
get-personalized-recommendations-meal-fe: HAVI looks at what you ate, how you moved, and how you're trending, then gives you one clear next step. Ask anything, anytime—meals, plateaus, cravings.
meals-hydration-workouts-sleep-steps: Meals, hydration, workouts, sleep, steps, cycle, mood, and GLP-1—plus a daily check-in, guided meditation, and workout videos. One app, so nothing needs a separate one.
havit-connects-what-you-log: HAVIT connects what you log with what you do next. That means fewer disconnected numbers and more useful daily direction.
havit-combines-ai-coaching-evidence: HAVIT combines AI coaching, evidence-based behavior-change techniques, and real-world weight-management expertise to help you make better decisions every day.
havit-is-a-wellness-app: HAVIT is a wellness app, not a medical device. Body composition results are estimates and are not equivalent to clinical measurements.
in-an-internal-study-with: In HAVIT's own internal study (n=70), our body composition model reached 92.9% estimated accuracy against InBody readings.
daily-missions-translate-established-beh: Daily missions translate established behavior-change techniques (BITs) into small, repeatable actions for everyday routines.
our-program-draws-on-the: Our program draws on the experience of professionals formerly at Juvis Diet, one of Korea's leading metabolic clinics.
feedback-from-havit-beta-participants: Reviews from HAVIT users. Individual experiences and results vary.
seeing-more-than-the-scale: "Seeing more than the scale helped me understand what was happening with my body for the first time."
the-missions-make-the-app: "The missions make the app feel engaging. I open it daily, and the streak helps me stay consistent."
other-apps-recorded-my-meals: "Other apps recorded my meals. HAVIT helped explain the reason behind the next choice."
access-over-1-400-articles: Access over 1,400 articles, available on both app and web.
yes-havit-is-designed-for: Yes. HAVIT is designed for anyone building healthier weight-management habits. GLP-1 logging and lifestyle support are optional features for people who use those medications under a healthcare professional’s care.
the-ai-coach-uses-the: The AI Coach uses the goals, preferences, logs, and progress you provide to offer personalized wellness guidance. It does not diagnose conditions, prescribe medication, or replace a qualified healthcare professional.
no-havit-provides-statistical-estimates: No. HAVIT provides statistical estimates for wellness tracking. They are not equivalent to measurements from a medical device or a clinical assessment, and individual results can vary.
you-can-track-meals-calories: You can track meals, calories and nutrients, weight and estimated body trends, activity, hydration, sleep, habits, and an optional GLP-1 medication routine. Available integrations can vary by device and region.
no-medication-decisions-including-starti: No. Medication decisions—including starting, stopping, changing dose, and managing side effects—must be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional. HAVIT only provides lifestyle information and personal logging tools.
havit-handles-personal-data-according: HAVIT handles personal data according to its Privacy Policy. Review the policy before signing up for details about collection, storage, sharing, retention, and deletion requests.
everything-you-need-to-lose: Your AI coach for losing weight, keeping muscle, and building habits that last—all in one app.
free-to-download-in-app: Free to download. In-app purchases may apply.
havit-provides-general-wellness-informat: HAVIT provides general wellness information and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

study-headline:
Clinically tested for 12 weeks.
Measured on InBody.
study-desc: In a 12-week clinical study with Eulji University, HAVIT users were compared with a control group. Every result comes from InBody measurements, not self-reported weight.
study-stat-1-label: more likely to lose 5%+ of body weight
study-stat-1-compare: 32% of HAVIT users vs 8% of the control group
study-stat-2-label: of HAVIT users lowered their body fat percentage
study-footnote: 12-week clinical study conducted with Eulji University, June–August 2026. Analysis of 78 participants (HAVIT 41, control 37) with InBody results at week 1 and week 12. 5%+ weight loss: 31.7% vs 8.1% (3.9×, p=0.012). Lower body fat percentage: 83% vs 49% (p=0.002). Unblinded study. Individual results vary. HAVIT is a wellness app and is not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any disease.

aff-faq-q1: Is the HAVIT Affiliate Program free to join?
aff-faq-a1: Yes. There is no fee to submit an application or participate as an approved partner.
aff-faq-a2: Creators, influencers, publishers, editorial sites, health and wellness communities, coaches, newsletters, podcasts, and other relevant partners may apply. Every application is reviewed individually.
aff-faq-q3: Can I promote HAVIT outside the United States?
aff-faq-a3: Yes. HAVIT is available internationally. Tracking is based on a user clicking your unique partner link and completing an eligible conversion, rather than being limited solely by the creator's or customer's country.
aff-faq-a4: You receive a unique tracking link through the affiliate platform. Eligible transactions are attributed when the tracked click and conversion are recorded successfully, subject to the program's attribution rules.
aff-faq-q5: When and how will I be paid?
aff-faq-a5: Approved commissions are processed through the affiliate platform according to its payment schedule, validation period, minimum payment rules, and the HAVIT Affiliate Program Terms.
aff-faq-a6: Only approved promotional methods may be used. Trademark bidding, misleading claims, unapproved discount messaging, and other restricted practices are prohibited unless HAVIT provides written authorization.
aff-faq-q7: Do I need to disclose the affiliate relationship?
aff-faq-a7: Yes. Partners must clearly disclose their relationship with HAVIT in accordance with applicable advertising, consumer protection, platform, and local disclosure requirements.
aff-final-desc: Applications are reviewed individually. Once approved you get your tracking link, brand assets, and approved messaging.
